criteria.name: Strategic negotiation plan (SSNP)
criteria.description: Quality of the strategic settlement and negotiation plan: interests, alternatives, and disciplined handling of the client's confidential facts.

subcriteria.name: Interests, priorities, and BATNA
subcriteria.description: Identifies the client's true interests and priorities (including access certainty, density, and timing) and a realistic BATNA, and infers the seller's likely interests.

subcriteria.name: Confidential-fact management and creative options
subcriteria.description: Protects the client's confidential facts (ceiling price, deadline, management LOI, septic cost) while generating at least three creative options to cure access.

criteria.name: Access-rights analysis (easement vs. license)
criteria.description: Correctly frames and researches whether the 1978 instrument created an easement appurtenant or a revocable license, and the effect of the pending city road vacation and title exception.

subcriteria.name: Easement vs. revocable license
subcriteria.description: Analyzes the character of the access right, the effect of the missing legal description and mislocated lane, and the paths to cure.

subcriteria.name: Road vacation and title impact
subcriteria.description: Assesses the proposed vacation of Verdant Shore Road, reversion to abutting owners, and the title commitment's access exception.

criteria.name: Purchase-agreement drafting
criteria.description: Drafts purchase-agreement terms — especially the access contingency and cure obligations — that actually protect the buyer.

subcriteria.name: Contingency and access provisions
subcriteria.description: Access contingency, cure obligation, title-objection, and closing-condition language allocate the access risk to the buyer's protection.

subcriteria.name: Clarity and completeness
subcriteria.description: Drafting is clear, internally consistent, and complete on price, closing, and remedies.

criteria.name: Client counseling and fact-gathering
criteria.description: Interviews the client effectively and counsels him on options and risks in plain, decision-useful terms.

criteria.name: Professional responsibility
criteria.description: Recognizes the no-contact limits on the represented seller, the propriety of dealing with the unrepresented neighbor, and any conflicts.
